body:
## Summary

- add a lightweight 2-GPU MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA server E2E case using the pinned official video+audio reference
- validate that expected video outputs contain decodable, non-silent audio
- compare generated audio against platform-specific WAV GT using spectral similarity, waveform correlation, RMS level, and duration
- preserve both frame and audio artifacts when GT is missing so one CI run provides everything needed to review a new baseline
- guard model-load and post-load runtime allocator peaks separately, taking MAX across all ranks in the replica
- use tighter VRAM limits: load peak `1% + 128 MiB`; runtime peak `2% + 128 MiB`
- publish both VRAM metrics in the pytest report, merged retry artifact, and diffusion dashboard artifact

## Regression coverage

This covers the Ref2VA reference-audio path missed by the existing mocked unit test and FL2VA/T2VA server cases. The branch currently includes the forward-context fix from #35481; once that PR merges, its diff will drop out here.

The load peak is frozen immediately after model initialization. The runtime peak starts from zero and covers warmup plus measured requests, so transient checkpoint materialization and serving-time workspace/activation regressions cannot mask each other.

## Validation

- remote focused unit tests before the metric split: `41 passed`
- full pre-commit at current head: passed
- 2x GB300 Ref2VA E2E: passed (`11.30s` request E2E after warmup)
- repeated audio metrics: spectral `0.9973`, waveform correlation `0.9988`, RMS delta `0.137 dB`, duration delta `0s`
- prior aggregate instrumentation check: request-local peak `35,994 MiB`; loading-inclusive replica peak `64,310 MiB`, demonstrating why load/runtime must be separated

H100 CI is required for the final platform GT and the per-platform VRAM baselines. Blackwell output will not be used as H100 ground truth.
